podcast.body: A song from the Pixies' 1989 album "Doolittle," it embodies the band's distinctive style. The Pixies, while not explicitly labeled as nerd rock, exhibited nerdy and geeky qualities that became influential on subsequent bands in the 1990s. "This is Monkey Gone to Heaven from their greatest album, 1989's Doodle."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Featured on their "Doolittle" album, this song exemplifies The Pixies' style. The band, originating from the University of Massachusetts, had members with unusual interests, such as one who moonlighted as a professional magician, and their songs often showed an interest in science fiction and astronomy, contributing to their nerdy image. "This is Monkey Gone to Heaven from their greatest album, 1989's Doodle."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
